definitions.modes: greedy probability-ordered disjoint content cores, group p >= 0.05
definitions.region_mass: all groups whose nonempty content core lies wholly within merged gold region
definitions.second_region: second-highest model region mass, rank among ALL content-core groups
definitions.q: uniform over distinct annotated groups, aggregated into regions; not human frequencies
definitions.divergences: natural log; rest bucket; p floored 1e-15 and normalized; JS square root
definitions.gold_overlap: overlap at counted content positions; invalid gold recorded as null
definitions.map: existing top-k normalized decoder; shape statistics use the FULL span/group distribution
